scope: Isolated direct BBS loopback real TLS HTTP/1.1; 2CPU/2GiB/80Mbps; shared host and SSD; no production deployment. Normal 20 posts/s, legacy/Web 80/20. Recovery p95 includes issuance wait.
limitations: Final candidate returns to the first healthy 3-second streak from the first recovery bin in all 6 trials, but 2 trials relapse later. Stable recovery improvement is not established.
Two final baseline trials fail flood_supplied: 1134/1200 and 1110/1200 requests issued. These results are retained.
I/O contention has the same scheduled rate, not the same completed sync count; achieved work varies with shared storage.
0ms recovery onset is a retrospective bin start at 1-second resolution; it is confirmed after 3 seconds. Censored observation means insufficient stable tail, not an exact recovery time.

OpenWithAdmission delays background starts; forced termination may lose additional in-memory detection events. View/Close still await durable saves. Posting persistence and success order are unchanged.
